github.gap_policy_reason: a GitHub snapshot only describes the window it covers, so a week without a snapshot is unknown rather than zero

unavailable_metrics.active_contributors: not collected by policy: commit author names, emails, and profiles are discarded at collection time, so distinct contributors cannot be counted
unavailable_metrics.issues_closed: not collected: only the current open_issues_count counter is retained, which includes pull requests and cannot be split into opened and closed events
unavailable_metrics.issues_opened: not collected: only the current open_issues_count counter is retained, which includes pull requests and cannot be split into opened and closed events
unavailable_metrics.releases: not collected: the GitHub collector reads repository fields, branches, and commits only; the releases endpoint is not requested

jobs.gap_policy_reason: a job-board snapshot describes only the weeks a collector ran; a week without a snapshot is unknown, not a hiring freeze
jobs.history_note: job data is collected prospectively, so these series are short by construction and will report insufficient_history until min_history weeks exist

news.dedup_note: attention is counted per origin cluster; syndicated copies of one origin are not independent corroboration (docs/evidence-ledger.md)
news.gap_policy_reason: news and company feeds are harvested continuously, so inside the coverage span a week with no article is a real zero rather than a missing observation
